name: AN-23-067-UL2017-full-grid-2d-calibration-pilot
notes: Pilot only: all 114 decay-specific signals (six channels at 19 nominal mass pairs) against the existing 23 disjoint background components; full signed dataset denominators remain unaudited.

Actual generated masses define each signal. HtZt_6000_2000 is the documented 6200/1950 substitute with log-linear interpolation of LO production only; config/signal_grid_2017.json and data/analysis_2017/signal_normalization_provenance.json record its normalization.

Use referenceWeight (pileup x prefiring x medium-b-tag correction), with signed generator weight multiplied once. There is no nominal TTbar top-pT correction. Cross sections already include the signal branching fractions; no extra branching or NLO factor is applied.

The fixed AN-based object, trigger, baseline and SR selection are combined with the scanned event jet-count/pT gate and scanned reconstruction settings. Physicality is disabled as both gate and metric.

The common 15x17 raw mass grid uses x=Suu mass from 2500 to10000 GeV in500-GeV bins and y=average superjet mass from750 to5000 GeV in250-GeV bins. Out-of-range entries are recorded separately and excluded, not folded into edge cells.

Per-cell and combined scores use the Asimov finite-background-MC model with sumw2 retained. The hard effective-count threshold is zero; sparse cells remain diagnosed. Nonpositive background with positive signal or invalid signed-weight yields remain unsupported, with no epsilon replacement.
The AN 17.5 percent criterion concerns merged superbins; this diagnostic raw grid does not apply it as a cell-level cut or claim to reproduce the final AN bin map.

Every processed preselection event enters the signed generator denominator, including events failing selection. Metadata normalization is limited to the declared representative subset; complete:true denotes the intended trial scope and does not certify full dataset or background-component coverage.

Calibration and main optimization must use identical source lists, file/event caps, weighting, binning and normalization. Expanding MC coverage or changing score physics requires fresh calibration and a new frozen reference file.
Files are populated by the controller after completed workers return; this template is not directly evaluable with empty files arrays.

Calibration uses mean Asimov significance only to obtain a declared set of reference scales. Freeze the maximum positive score per required benchmark over the complete feasible calibration cohort; these are calibration scales, not known global optima. The small default trial budget may fail to provide positive supported coverage for every benchmark; do not fabricate or omit missing references.

samples.name: HtZt_6000_2000

production_interpolation.scope: LO production cross section only; actual6200/1950 branching fraction evaluated separately
production_interpolation.limitation: Approximation between published source grid values; no additional theory-uncertainty estimate is assigned by this nominal catalog.

samples.mass_mismatch_note: The sample name is a nominal-grid alias. Existing list header and docs/compact_scan_evaluation.md document the generated6200/1950 substitute for unavailable HTZT6000/2000. Event normalization uses actual generated masses, not the nominal alias.
